focusedAudit.reason: 0.9.0 is Tine Beta 0.9.0-beta.14 with its app code unchanged (tested by Beta users since 2026-11-15, the 0.9 line since 2026-10-29), plus the stable identity flip, version metadata, the regenerated comparison page and the master-only docs/website content carried in cada466f1. Martin authorized the cut on 2026-11-15 (D-20261115-STC) and confirmed it on 2026-11-16; #964 and the CLI move-indent fix go to 0.9.1, and the release notes carry the #964 known issue (D-20261115-964). items.text: Stable Tine now carries the 0.9 Beta line. Beta keeps its separate app and update channel, and continues with the next development line.
